From the Great Kingdom of Ekpatanus to the Resteium Federation:

To our newly established neighbor, Resteium, we extend our warm greetings.

It is important to note that the two large islands located to your east rightfully belong to the Kingdom of Ekpatanus. These islands, our ancestral lands, were to be returned to our homeland soon; however, this has unfortunately been delayed due to the outbreak of war between our allies, Jomsland and Gendarme, with the socialist government of New Arenenge. Furthermore, we find it necessary to maintain control over these islands for our national security and strategic interests.

In light of this, the Kingdom of Ekpatanus is prepared to purchase these two islands from you at a fair price, which you may determine. Moreover, His Majesty King Kaesarus III Sam Michaelidis guarantees that, upon reaching an agreement, we will not advance westward from the coastline, thereby providing your government with the opportunity to recover and expand your newly established territory.

We sincerely hope that the Federation will make a rational decision, thus preventing any potential tensions or misunderstandings on the continent of Elseyr.

Jürgen Andropoulos
Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Great Kingdom of Ekpatanus
[nation]Resteium[/nation]
